After Security.name: 5 Boroughs Food Emporium
After Security.description: 5 Boroughs Food Emporium offers a modern, dynamic energetic marketplace curated with a great selection of snacks, treats, sandwiches, drinks and more from local purveyors.

After Security.name: AG1 Automated Retail
After Security.description: Daily on-the-go nutritional powder packs with foundational vitamins, minerals, probiotics, adaptogens, and whole-food nutrients supporting energy, immunity and gut health.

After Security.name: Artichoke Pizza
After Security.description: Artichoke Pizza is known for its signature artichoke slice and New York style pizza. It delivers a classic, indulgent city favorite in a quick-serve format.

After Security.name: Auntie Anne's
After Security.description: Auntie Anne's serves freshly baked pretzels and snacks in a quick service format. It's a popular stop for a warm, savory bite on the go.

After Security.name: Bar 212
After Security.description: Bar 212 features New American classics highlighting fresh, locally-sourced ingredients, paired alongside hand-crafted cocktails.

After Security.name: Bar Veloce
After Security.description: Opened by oenophile and restauranteur Fredrick Twomey, Bar Veloce has been a long-standing NYC favorite in the East Village since 2000. Guests will enjoy wine & beer sourced from all over the world with something for every taste which can be thoughtfully paired with a menu of tapas-style small plates and hot-pressed panini sandwiches.

After Security.name: Beecher's Handmade Cheese / Sweetleaf Coffee Roasters
After Security.description:
Showcasing the best in artisanal fare, Beecher's Market Café will delight passengers with exceptional, handcrafted meals to go and carefully sourced, regional products. Featuring an all-day menu including favorites such as the Oprah-endorsed "World's Best" Mac & Cheese, grilled cheese sandwiches, soup, salads, wraps and more!

Sweetleaf coffee is the perfect blend of art and science. Sweetleaf was founded in 2008 by Rich Nieto, a Queens native who wanted to roast coffee that reflects New York City: diverse, sophisticated and decidedly unique.

After Security.name: Birch Coffee / H&H Bagels / Rossi Pizzeria
After Security.description: Birch Coffee / H&H Bagels / Rossi Pizzeria is a multi-concept dining area offering coffee, classic New York bagels, and pizza. It provides quick, familiar options for travelers at any time of the day.

After Security.name: Brklyn's Best Bagels / Kombu
After Security.description: Brklyn's Best Bagels / Kombu combines traditional New York bagels with Japanese-inspired offerings. It provides a diverse menu blending classic and modern flavors.

After Security.name: Brooklyn Diner
After Security.description: Celebrating the borough of Brooklyn's diverse culinary history with classic American dishes that have a distinct ethnic personality-dishes that define America's melting pot cuisine, Brooklyn Diner features scratch-made specialties including house-cured hot pastrami, chicken pot pie and double-fisted hamburgers, as well as tacos, burritos, frankfurters and pasta. From the bar, guests can enjoy a wide range of local craft brews, premium wines and handcrafted cocktails, as well as soft drinks, tea and coffee.

After Security.name: Bubby's
After Security.description: New York City's beloved cozy and boozy restaurant and pie shop, Bubby's, opened on Thanksgiving Day 1990. Chef and Owner Ron Silver began baking pies and selling them to restaurants and his neighbors out of a small kitchen in Tribeca. The concept focuses on simple and fresh, no fuss comfort food made from scratch American cooking. Bubby's has the quintessential comfort dish for everyone - crispy fried chicken, light and fluffy traditional pancakes, delectable pies, and homemade buttermilk biscuits! The menu is chef driven featuring ingredients sourced from local farms and small purveyors.

After Security.name: BuzzFeed
After Security.description: Newstand selling snacks, magazines, and other media.

After Security.name: BuzzFeed
After Security.description: Newstand and shop offering a wide variety of snacks, drinks, grab-n-go and media.

After Security.name: Calista Taverna
After Security.description: Full-service Greek Mediterranean restaurant and bar that also serves breakfast from 5:00AM to 10:30AM

After Security.name: Capital One Landing
After Security.description: The Capital One Landing at LaGuardia (LGA) is an airport culinary experience, featuring elevated tapas-styles plates and beverages curated by José Andrés Group. Enjoy delicious food and beverage options, whether that be a leisurely meal or quick bite en route to your gate. Intentional design with first-class finishes, local artwork that bring the space to life and essential travel amenities like luggage nooks, convenient outlets and high-speed Wi-Fi. The Landing is located in Terminal B skybridge on your way to Gates 11-31.

After Security.name: Chopt
After Security.description: Take away restaurant with a variety of salad offerings.

After Security.name: CIBO Express Foodhall
After Security.description: CIBO Express Foodhall has a variety of takeaway restaurants, as well as grab-and-go food products.

After Security.description: Cotto Trattoria & Market Place is open for sit-down dining, with breakfast served daily until 10:00 AM, while the Market Place opens at 4:00 AM offering grab-and-go options for travelers.

After Security.name: District Market
After Security.description: District Market is a NYC themed marketplace featuring grab & go snacks, travel essentials, local and national gifts, souvenirs, toys, books, magazines, and more!

After Security.name: Dos Toros
After Security.description: Dos Toros is a takeaway taqueria chain that offers fresh, flavorful and melty burritos, tacos, quesadillas, bowls, salads and nachos.

After Security.name: Dos Toros Taqueria
After Security.description: New York City's original mission-style taqueria, serving burritos, tacos, bowls and salads made from scratch, using only fresh ingredients and naturally raised meats.

After Security.name: Dunkin'
After Security.description: LGA runs on Dunkin'! Enjoy Dunkin's original blend of premium coffee as well as freshly baked donuts, breakfast sandwiches and packaged snacks, salads, yogurts and fruit.

After Security.name: Eggy Weggy / Essex Burger
After Security.description: Eggy Weggy serves breakfast options until 10:00AM, Essex Burger lunch and dinner options begin at 10:30AM

After Security.name: FAO Schwarz
After Security.description: FAO Schwarz has been a brand synonymous with quality and innovation, offering an unparalleled selection of extraordinary toys that have enchanted generations and cultivated a loyal clientele. LaGuardia's FAO Schwarz location will feature an FAO Schweetz shop-in-shop experience, offering classic and nostalgic candy treats from everyone's favorite toy store.

After Security.name: Fiorello Market
After Security.description: You'll find various gifts and keepsakes as well as prepared food at this convenient retail shop.

After Security.name: Flatiron Tavern & Provisions
After Security.description: Fill up yourself with some straightforward yet elevated American cuisine prepared with care at Flatiron Tavern & Provisions.

After Security.name: Freshii
After Security.description: Freshii focuses on healthy, fast-casual options like bowls, wraps, and smoothies. It's ideal for travelers looking for lighter, nutritious meals.

After Security.name: Gotham News
After Security.description: Gotham News offers a curated selection of travel essentials, local snacks, beverages, tech, souvenirs and reading materials. Stop in for last-minute needs and everyday travel comforts.

After Security.name: Green Leaf's
After Security.description: Serving chef-inspired salads, wraps, grain bowls, smoothies and fresh juices, using only the highest quality ingredients.

After Security.name: Hill Country Barbecue Market
After Security.description: Based in New York City, barbecue and fried chicken straight from the Hill Country of Texas. Serving a selection of barbecue including chopped brisket and pulled pork, as well as mouthwatering fried chicken and Texas sized tenders with an array of classic sides.

After Security.name: Hudson
After Security.description: Hudson, an iconic New York City staple, is an internationally-recognized travel essentials and convenience concept designed with customer ease at its core. Hudson delivers the lifestyle shopping experience preferred by today's traveler.

After Security.name: Hunt and Fish Grill
After Security.description: A contemporary New York steakhouse offering the classic cuts of beef and innovative dishes.

After Security.name: Il Viaggio
After Security.description: Il Viaggio is a modern spin on the classic Italian restaurant highlighting the most iconic culinary destinations across Italy.  Offering a wide variety of Italian inspired dishes, including classic tomato stewed meatballs, baked goat cheese, authentic chicken parmesan and a myriad of handcrafted pizzas.  And let's not forget breakfast with a full array of favorites to start the day.  To complement the full menu is a carefully crafted wine, beer and cocktail menu featuring many of the classics and even local picks from right here in New York State.

After Security.name: Irving Farm Coffee Roasters
After Security.description: A bona fide New York institution, Irving Farm Coffee Roasters has been an important fixture on New York's coffee scene since it was founded as a neighborhood café near Gramercy Park in 1996.

After Security.name: Jamba Juice
After Security.description: Jamba Juice offers smoothies, juices, and light snacks made with fruit and wholesome ingredients. It's a refreshing option for travelers seeking a quick pick-me-up.

After Security.name: Jersey Mike's
After Security.description: Jersey Mike's specializes in fresh-sliced subs made to order with quality ingredients. It provides a hearty, customizable meal option.

After Security.name: Juice Press
After Security.description: Refresh and refuel with a made to order smoothie from Juice Press.

After Security.name: Junior's Restaurant and Cheesecake
After Security.description: Originally opened in the heart of Brooklyn in 1950, over 65 years and three generations later, Junior's continues to be the epitome of New York comfort food. Serving sliced deli sandwiches, hot Reubens, juicy burgers, fresh cut fries, hearty breakfasts, and of course the best cheesecake in the world!

After Security.name: King David Tacos
After Security.description: King David Tacos offers Austin-style breakfast tacos with bold flavors and fresh ingredients. It's a unique and satisfying option for a quick bite.

After Security.name: La Chula Bar & Taqueria
After Security.description: La Chula brings authentic 5 star quality Mexican food by Chef Julian Medina and redefines what quick-serve Mexican dining looks like.

After Security.name: Mad Ave. Market
After Security.description: Pick up all the essentials and treats you need for your flight -- snacks, beverages, reading materials and more.

After Security.name: Magnolia Bakery
After Security.description: Magnolia Bakery is known for its classic desserts, including cupcakes and banana pudding. It offers a sweet treat option for travelers looking to indulge

After Security.name: Melt Shop
After Security.description: Melt Shop is a fast-casual restaurant chain founded in NYC in 2011, specializing in gourmet grilled cheese sandwiches, melts, tater tots, and hand-spun milkshakes. Known for comfort food, it offers quick, elevated takes on classic cheese melts.

After Security.name: Mi Casa Cantina
After Security.description: Mi Casa offers fast, freshly made Mexican street food jam-packed full with an explosion of fresh flavors.

After Security.name: Mulberry Street
After Security.description: Mulberry Street by Marc Forgione brings the best of this hometown gastronaut's critically acclaimed plates and serves them in a wholly engaging, casual meets culinary chef-led dining experience. Passengers are invited to sit-down, relax and watch their meal prepared in real-time. This isn't just a chef-driven restaurant. Mulberry Street is a bona fide culinary experience.

After Security.name: NY Creperie
After Security.description: NY Creperie offers sweet and savory selections filled with fresh combinations for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and dessert. Sandwiches, coffee and smoothies are also available.

After Security.name: Panorama Bar
After Security.description: An inviting New York bar for worldly travelers to gather, LaGuardia's Panorama Bar & Lounge transports everyday travelers to their next envy-worthy destination. It offers stunning panoramic views of the airport's skyline. Panorama Bar & Lounge is known for its spacious layout, making it a perfect spot for socializing and enjoying the scenery. The bar serves a wide selection of cocktails, wines, beers, and spirits, accompanied by a menu of appetizers, small plates, and light bites.

After Security.name: Poppy's Bagels / Chuko Ramen
After Security.description: Poppy's Bagels serves breakfast favorites from 5:00am to 10:30am. Chuko Ramen has a full-service restaurant and bar serving Asian fare.

After Security.name: Potbelly
After Security.description: Potbelly offers toasted sandwiches, soups, and salads in a casual setting. It's a great choice for a warm, quick meal before boarding.

After Security.name: Prime Steakhouse
After Security.description: Full service bar and restaurant serving steakhouse favorites, a variety of salads and sandwiches, and a kid's menu.

After Security.name: Protein Bar & Kitchen
After Security.description: Protein Bar & Kitchen serves protein-focused meals, shakes, and snacks designed for a healthy lifestyle.

After Security.name: Shake Shack
After Security.description: Shake Shack is a modern day burger stand. A once local favorite founded by revered New York restaurateur Danny Meyer, it has since grown into a global phenomenon.

After Security.name: Soleil Brasserie
After Security.description: Full-service bar and sit-down restaurant serving entrees, sandwiches, salads and desserts.  Grab and go options available including breakfast from 5:00AM to 10:30AM.

After Security.name: Spirit & Bell
After Security.description: Created specifically for Terminal B by one of New York's most influential hospitality teams, Spirit & Bell serves up a full-service wine and cocktail bar which features one of the world's best cocktail menus.

After Security.name: Taim Mediterranean Kitchen
After Security.description: Taim serves Mediterranean-inspired dishes including falafel, hummus, and bowls. It's a flavorful and fresh option for a quick, healthy meal.

After Security.name: Talde Noodle Bar
After Security.description: Asian fusion restaurant by celebrity chef Dale Talde, offering elevated noodle dishes, small plates, and cocktails with both dine-in and takeout options. Known for its blend of traditional Asian recipes with modern techniques, featuring items like ramen, crispy chicken noodles, and bao buns.

After Security.name: Terrace Bar
After Security.description: Terrace Bar offers a relaxed bar setting with a selection of cocktails, beer, and wine. It provides a comfortable space for travelers to unwind before their flight.

After Security.name: The Bowery Bay Shops
After Security.description: The Bowery Bay Shops is a state of the art 15,000 square foot immersive shopping experience featuring local NYC artisanal food and gifts, grab & go snacks, souvenirs, mens and womens fashion, NY sports apparel, Strand Bookstore, Kate Spade, L'Oreal Beauty Hub, LEGO,  travel essentials, and the latest tech and travel accessories!

After Security.name: The Grille
After Security.description: The Grille offers travelers a taste of classic American cuisine with a contemporary twist. Menu highlights include the Western Blue Ring Burger, Southern Belle Chicken Sandwich, and the Seared Ahi Sandwich, alongside a delectable NY Strip and a kid-friendly menu.

After Security.name: The Line Sports Grill
After Security.description: The Line Sports Grill is a full-service sports bar featuring classic American fare and multiple screens for live games. It provides a lively atmosphere for dining and relaxing.

After Security.name: Tony and Benny's Pizza Parlor
After Security.description: A traditional pizza parlor straight from the streets of Brooklyn. Serving pizza by the slice, pasta smothered in house-made sauce and other traditional Italian recipes and flavors delivered with just the right amount of Brooklyn attitude and flair.

After Security.name: Trinity Burgers
After Security.description: A takeout eatery offering hamburgers, hotdogs and french fries.

After Security.name: Uptown Essentials
After Security.description: Your quick stop for New York favorites and everyday cravings. Grab fresh sandwiches, sushi, pastries, snacks, candy, chocolate, cold drinks, and more for your travels!

After Security.name: W.H. Smith
After Security.description: WHSmith,  powered by Amazon's Just Walk Out technology, offers everyday travel must-haves in a convenient, checkout-free environment.

After Security.name: Wendy's
After Security.description: Dig into a classic Wendy's single, double or triple. Spice things up with some zesty chili. Or grab a signature garden-fresh salad. Whatever you do, don't forget the Frosty!

After Security.name: Wendy's
After Security.description: Wendy's serves classic fast-food favorites including burgers, chicken sandwiches, and fries. It's reliable, quick service option for travelers on the go.

After Security.name: Zaro's Family Bakery
After Security.description: A fourth-generation Bronx bakery since 1927, Zaro's has expanded throughout the New York Metropolitan area becoming a household name in one of the busiest commuter hubs in the world. Enjoy a fresh selection of quality baked goods such as bagels and pastries, deli sandwiches, and Zaro's very own house blend coffee.

Before Security.name: CIBO Express Gourmet Markets
Before Security.description: CIBO Express Gourmet Markets is a convenient grab-and-go market offering fresh snacks, beverages, and travel essentials for passengers on the move. It provides a quick, reliable, option for quality food and last-minute items.

Before Security.description: LGA runs on Dunkin'! Enjoy Dunkin's original blend of premium coffee as well as freshly baked donuts, breakfast sandwiches and packaged snacks, salads, yogurts, and fruit.

Before Security.name: Mezze
Before Security.description: Modern fast-casual Mediterranean on the go. Wholesome, flavorful meals made with fresh, high-quality ingredients. From gourmet sandwiches on rustic breads to hearty hot entrées and fresh-baked pastries, Mezze offers something for everyone.

Before Security.name: NYC Aglow
Before Security.description: Celebrating the lights of NYC, NYC Aglow has everything travelers need to keep shining in the city that never sleeps. You can bask in the store's reimagined skyline as you pick up a souvenir, a cold drink, healthy snacks or a newspaper without leaving the terminal.

Before Security.name: Orpheus + Apollo
Before Security.description: The Orpheus and Apollo Lounge is a landside bar on the mezzanine level of The Atrium Business & Conference Center, located pre-security at Terminal B. The lounge offers 136 first-class seats, craft cocktails and snacks to be enjoyed with views of LaGuardia Airport's active tarmac and Richard Lippold's iconic Orpheus and Apollo sculpture.

Before Security.name: Pour Authority
Before Security.description: Pour Authority is a coffee shop by day and bar by night, located on the ground level of The Atrium Business & Conference Center, pre-security at Terminal B. Grab a cup of joe and sandwich on-the-go or relax with a glass of wine and snack before your flight. Join the loyalty program and earn points with every fly-by!
